module: Flowgraph node "Transform" (provider category, d_rotation icon): provides a 3D position, rotation and scale editable in the editor. Output pins: "pos" (vec3), "rot" (quat) and "scl" (vec3), as {x,y,z} / {x,y,z,w} tables. Two modes: "gizmo" (edited with the World Editor gizmo, DragFloats or the camera/terrain buttons) and "fromID" (an input pin "objID" is added; the node copies position/rotation/scale from the matching scene object). In the editor it draws a preview volume (display modes default, sphereX/Y/Z, halfBox, fullBox, aproxVehicle) with debugDrawer.
notes: The outputs are only recomputed if 'changed' is true (or every frame in fromID mode); _executionStarted/_executionStopped set 'changed' back to true.
The initial position is placed 15 m in front of the editor camera.
The values are serialized in position, rotation, scale, markerClr, mode, useQuatForRotation and displayMode; fromID mode recreates the objID pin on load.
The 'aproxVehicle' display mode draws a box approximating a vehicle (2 x 4.2 x 1.8 times the scale) around the position.

_executionStarted.desc: Forces the outputs to be rewritten at start (changed = true).

_executionStopped.desc: Forces the outputs to be rewritten at the next start (changed = true).

_onDeserialized.desc: Restores the node's state from the saved data.

_onSerialize.desc: Writes the node's state to the save table.

drawAxisBox.desc: Draws a solid box (triangles) and its black edges from a corner and three edge vectors.

drawCustom.desc: Draws the gizmo mode controls: display mode, position, rotation (euler in degrees or quaternion), scale, color, buttons "Copy from selection", "Position in front of camera / at camera", "Rotation at camera", "Drop to terrain".

drawCustomProperties.desc: Mode combo (gizmo/fromID) — adds or removes the objID pin — then drawCustom in gizmo mode.

drawMiddle.desc: Draws the colored X/Y/Z axes (spheres and lines) and the preview volume according to displayMode.

builder.desc: Editor node builder (builder:Middle() opens the central area).

style.desc: Node display style provided by the editor.

gizmoBeginDrag.desc: Start of a gizmo drag: stores the original rotation, scale and position.

gizmoDragging.desc: During the gizmo drag: updates position (translation), rotation (rotation, in local frame or relative to the start) or scale (component by component) depending on the gizmo mode, and draws the axes.

gizmoEndDrag.desc: End of a gizmo drag (called by editor.updateAxisGizmo); updates the node's state.

hideProperties.desc: Called when the node is deselected: removes the gizmo and goes back to the objectSelect edit mode.

init.desc: Sets the position 15 m in front of the camera, identity rotation, scale (1,1,1), semi-transparent red marker color, mode 'gizmo' and displayMode 'halfBox'.

showProperties.desc: Called when the node is selected in the editor: plugs in the 'flowgraphTransform' edit mode with the World Editor axis gizmo.

updateTransform.desc: Synchronizes the gizmo matrix with the node's position and rotation (rotation ignored if the gizmo is in world alignment).

work.desc: In fromID mode, copies position/rotation/scale from the object objID; if 'changed', writes the three output pins.
